_schema.research_method: Web search on 2026-09-20 for thresholds and authorities; vehicle facts come from data/idiq-vehicles.json and are never restated here. Direct fetch was blocked by the session proxy.
_schema.status_check: Before citing any route that runs on a vehicle, read /api/v1/vehicles/{vehicle_id} for ordering_status, ordering_end and as_of. A route in this file does not carry vehicle status on its own.

routes.name: Micro-purchase
routes.mechanism: A government purchase card or simple order at or below the micro-purchase threshold, with no competition required.
prerequisites: SAM.gov registration
A program office with card authority
routes.fit: Pilots, trial licenses, small data purchases. Not a market entry strategy on its own.

sources.label: Federal Register 2025-08-27: inflation adjustment of acquisition-related thresholds
GSA SmartPay bulletin: micro-purchase threshold $15,000 effective 2025-10-01

routes.name: Simplified acquisition
routes.mechanism: Simplified procedures for purchases at or below the simplified acquisition threshold, usually reserved for small business between the micro-purchase threshold and the SAT.
prerequisites: SAM.gov registration
Small business status helps: the range is set aside for small business by default
routes.fit: A first pilot or a bounded implementation with one program office.

sources.label: Federal Register 2025-08-27: inflation adjustment of acquisition-related thresholds

routes.name: 8(a) sole source
routes.mechanism: A direct award to an SBA 8(a) participant below the sole-source ceiling, or above it for entity-owned (tribal, ANC, NHO) firms.
prerequisites: Certified 8(a) participant, or a teaming arrangement with one
At IHS, the Buy Indian Act set-asides (ISBEE and IEE) run alongside
routes.fit: The fastest legitimate direct award for a small firm with a sponsor inside the program office.

sources.label: Federal Register 2025-08-27: inflation adjustment of acquisition-related thresholds

routes.name: GSA Multiple Award Schedule order
routes.mechanism: An order against the vendor's own MAS contract (IT category) under FAR 8.4. State and local governments may also order through Cooperative Purchasing.
routes.authority: FAR Subpart 8.4; 40 U.S.C. 502(c) for state and local
prerequisites: A MAS contract, or a reseller or distributor that lists the product
MAS Refresh 31 (April 2026) made Transactional Data Reporting mandatory for all SINs (MMT lib/regulatory-flags.js)
routes.fit: The default commercial software route into every HHS operating division and, through Cooperative Purchasing, into state agencies.

routes.name: Government-wide acquisition contract task order
routes.mechanism: A task order competed among holders of a GWAC. A vendor without a seat sells through a prime that holds one.
prerequisites: A prime relationship on the target vehicle, or a seat on it
Check ordering_status: the NITAAC GWACs stop taking new orders 2026-10-29 and NASA SEWP VI opens ordering 2026-11-01 (MMT vehicle baseline)
routes.fit: Where most HHS and VA IT services dollars move. For a product company this is a reseller or subcontract route, not a prime route.

routes.name: Agency IDIQ task order
routes.mechanism: A task order under an agency's own multiple-award or single-award IDIQ, competed among its holders or issued to the single awardee.
prerequisites: A prime on the vehicle, or a seat
Read ordering_status before naming a vehicle: SPARC stops taking new orders 2027-02-20 with no successor planned (CMS)
routes.fit: The main route into VA (T4NG2, VECTOR), DHA (GSP, PEO DHMS vehicles) and CMS (SPARC until February 2027).

routes.name: Reseller or distributor route
routes.mechanism: The product is sold on a reseller's MAS contract, Army CHESS ITES-SW2, NASA SEWP, or a NASPO ValuePoint master agreement. The reseller holds the paper; the vendor holds the customer.
prerequisites: A signed reseller agreement with a holder of the target vehicle
ITES-SW2 and SEWP VI status: see the MMT vehicle baseline (known-vehicles.js) before citing
routes.fit: The quickest first federal transaction for a commercial software product; margin and relationship control go to the reseller.

sources.label: NASPO ValuePoint: Cloud and Software Solutions portfolio

routes.name: Commercial Solutions Opening
routes.mechanism: A general solicitation for innovative commercial products and services, selected through peer review of proposals against posted Areas of Interest.
prerequisites: An open Area of Interest that matches the product (data/cso-aois.json)
routes.fit: DHA's fast door for a commercial product with no vehicle seat. Respond to the AoI, not the CSO.

routes.name: Other transaction through a consortium
routes.mechanism: A prototype project awarded by a consortium manager (MTEC) to a member under a DoD other transaction agreement.
prerequisites: MTEC membership in good standing
routes.fit: Research and prototype work for military medicine, not enterprise IT operations.

routes.name: Broad agency announcement or Innovative Solution Opening
routes.mechanism: Proposals against a standing announcement for research and development (BARDA BAA, DRIVe EZ-BAA, ARPA-H Mission Office ISOs and Open BAA).
prerequisites: A research or development proposition, not a commercial sale
routes.fit: Funding for development; a different motion from services procurement.

routes.name: SBIR Phase III award
routes.mechanism: A sole-source award for work that derives from, extends or completes prior SBIR effort, funded with non-SBIR money.
prerequisites: A prior Phase I or Phase II award on the same technology
An agency or prime that wants to buy; at HHS this is not typical (see innovation-pathways.json sbir_sttr)
routes.fit: Real at DoD. At HHS, treat any plan that depends on it as needing a replacement route.

routes.name: CMS Innovation Center model vendor role
routes.mechanism: Selection as a technology vendor inside an Innovation Center model test (WISeR in 2026).
prerequisites: A model with a vendor application window
routes.fit: A pilot at scale with CMS as the customer, outside SPARC.

sources.label: DLA Piper: CMS launches WISeR model

routes.name: Unsolicited proposal or agency front door
routes.mechanism: VA Pathfinder routes a vendor idea to the right office; FAR 15.6 governs a formal unsolicited proposal.
prerequisites: A unique idea not available elsewhere, or a VA program office willing to sponsor a pilot
routes.fit: A conversation starter, not an award route.

routes.name: State cooperative contract (NASPO ValuePoint or GSA Cooperative Purchasing)
routes.mechanism: A state or its subdivision orders under a NASPO ValuePoint master agreement through its Participating Addendum, or under a GSA MAS IT contract through Cooperative Purchasing.
routes.authority: State procurement law and the Participating Addendum; 40 U.S.C. 502(c)
prerequisites: A NASPO ValuePoint master agreement (58 suppliers on Cloud and Software Solutions 2026 to 2036) or a MAS IT contract, or a partner that holds one
The target state's Participating Addendum
Any state security program the state requires (GovRAMP, TX-RAMP)
routes.fit: The fastest route into a state Medicaid agency for commercial software; the APD and certification rules still apply when federal match is claimed.

sources.label: NASPO ValuePoint: Cloud and Software Solutions portfolio

routes.name: State competitive procurement under an approved APD
routes.mechanism: A state RFP for an MES module or service, funded at 90 percent (DDI) or 75 percent (operations) federal match under a CMS-approved Advance Planning Document, certified through Streamlined Modular Certification.
routes.authority: 42 CFR 433 Subpart C; 45 CFR Part 95 Subpart F; SMDL 22-001

thresholds.label: APD prior approval, total acquisition at regular match

prerequisites: A state APD that names the module
MARS-E for eligibility systems
A certification plan under SMC with CMS-required outcomes
routes.fit: The main route for MES modules. Long cycle, high match, certification-bound.

routes.name: Routes that are closed, cancelled or closing (do not plan on these)
routes.mechanism: Vehicles a plan should not depend on. Each carries its status in data/idiq-vehicles.json; the API's ordering_status is the live read.
routes.fit: CIO-SP4 was cancelled 2026-01-30 with no successor; CIO-SP3 and CIO-CS take no new orders after 2026-10-29; SPARC takes no new orders after 2027-02-20 and CMS plans no replacement; the FDA Enterprise IT App Dev BPA was cancelled; DHA MSS ordering ended October 2025; ITES-3H expired February 2026 (ITES-4H is the follow-on).
